comments.text: Always amazed at the similarity between the south indian dosa and the enjira. ~10yrs ago human migration out of africa was traced using the male DNA marker -- fewer mutations of male DNA indicates closer genetic proximity to the source which is the kalahari bushmen. They found a guy in tamilnadu India whi had the original unmodified DNA of the kalahari -- ~500 generations of arranged marriage perhaps? Point is, there is shared ancestry and heritage between India and africa, especially south india, which has lesser mixing than in the north due to muslim invasions.
